about: Policy rule P13 (milestone 0014 Story 02.0 Task 03; ADR 0005). Every uses: in a workflow must appear here. Changing an entry: run 'gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/tags/<version>' (dereference an annotated tag with 'gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/tags/<tag sha>'), check the commit equals sha, record the date in tag_commit_verified_on. 'python3 scripts/ci/check_workflow_policy.py --verify-tags' does the lookup (network, not CI).

actions.justification: Checks out the commit under test; runs with persist-credentials: false (P14).
Restores the vcpkg binary cache; restore-only on every event (Task 02 cache rules).
Saves the vcpkg binary cache, only on a master push or schedule (P15).
Combined restore+save, used by today's ci.yml until cutover; new workflows use cache/restore and cache/save.
Uploads configure/build logs on failure (plan Q3, 3-day retention) and stage hand-off artifacts.
